legend: Having read half of the book called "Storm and Calm" on the IT lesson, Innocentius was absolutely determined to finish the book on the maths lessons. All was fine until the math teacher Ms. Watkins saw Innocentius reading fiction books instead of solving equations of the fifth degree. As during the last maths class Innocentius suggested the algorithm of solving equations of the fifth degree in the general case, Ms. Watkins had no other choice but to give him a new task.

The teacher asked to write consecutively (without spaces) all words from the "Storm and Calm" in one long string s. She thought that a string is good if the number of vowels in the string is no more than twice more than the number of consonants. That is, the string with v vowels and c consonants is good if and only if v ≤ 2c.
The task Innocentius had to solve turned out to be rather simple: he should find the number of the longest good substrings of the string s.
input: The only input line contains a non-empty string s consisting of no more than 2·105 uppercase and lowercase Latin letters. We shall regard letters "a", "e", "i", "o", "u" and their uppercase variants as vowels.
output: Print on a single line two numbers without a space: the maximum length of a good substring and the number of good substrings with this length. If no good substring exists, print "No solution" without the quotes.
Two substrings are considered different if their positions of occurrence are different. So if some string occurs more than once, then it should be counted more than once.
note: In the first sample there is only one longest good substring: "Abo" itself. The other good substrings are "b", "Ab", "bo", but these substrings have shorter length.
In the second sample there is only one longest good substring: "EIS". The other good substrings are: "S", "IS".

legend.ai: 在 IT 课上读了《Storm and Calm》这本书的一半后，Innocentius 下定决心要在数学课上把它读完。一切都很顺利，直到数学老师 Watkins 女士看到 Innocentius 没有在解五次方程，而是在读小说。由于在上一次数学课上，Innocentius 提出了在一般情况下求解五次方程的算法，Watkins 女士别无选择，只能给他一个新任务。
老师要求把《Storm and Calm》中的所有单词连续地（不加空格）写成一个长字符串 s。她认为，如果一个字符串中元音字母的数量不超过辅音字母数量的两倍，那么这个字符串就是好的。也就是说，一个有 v 个元音字母和 c 个辅音字母的字符串是好的，当且仅当 v ≤ 2c。
Innocentius 需要完成的任务其实相当简单：他应当求出字符串 s 中最长好子串的数量。

input.ai: 唯一的输入行包含一个非空字符串 s，其长度不超过 2·10^5，由大小写拉丁字母组成。我们将字母 “a”、“e”、“i”、“o”、“u” 及其大写形式视为元音。

output.ai: 在单独一行中输出两个数，中间不留空格：好子串的最大长度，以及具有该长度的好子串数量。如果不存在好子串，则输出 “No solution”（不含引号）。
如果两个子串的出现位置不同，则认为它们不同。因此，如果某个串出现多次，则应被计数多次。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，只有一个最长好子串：“Abo” 本身。其他好子串为 “b”、“Ab”、“bo”，但这些子串的长度较短。
在第二个样例中，只有一个最长好子串：“EIS”。其他好子串为 “S”、“IS”。
